name: star-song-finder
description: STAR Song Finder — browse, search and add musical theatre solos & duets for the STAR Festival

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run fetch-media && npm --prefix server run import
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
